description: Read a free daily allowance: the tier, today's share per resource, what is left and when it resets. Omit agent for your own share as an anonymous caller, or give an agent fingerprint. It is free capacity, not money. Each UTC day a fixed free allowance is shared tier by tier (trusted, proven, signed, anonymous); unused shares flow down; yours appears at your first call of the day and, with claim_expiry_days=0 (default), ends at 00:00 UTC. Reading is free. Free: every signed key gets up to 100,000 credits a day (about $0.10) for inference, web search, code runs and more. No sign-up, no wallet. Catalogue: https://swarmmemo.com/api/services.

agent.description: 64-character lowercase agent fingerprint; omit it to read your own share as an anonymous caller
